verses.englishText: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

verses.arabicText: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verses.englishText: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

verses.arabicText: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verses.englishText: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.[1955]
verses.footnotes: [1955] Bringing the exact measures apportioned for everything by Allāh in the course of the coming year.

verses.englishText: Peace it is[1956] until the emergence of dawn.
